title: Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyoku Naritai! Specials
justification: AniList 20522 has 6 episodes (2013-12-12 to 2014-05-12). AniDB 9794 S1-S6 (titles 'Special 1..6' in English; Japanese: Shougeki no Doro Wrestling!, Hissatsu no Lotion-zumou!, Daikessen! Nettouburo!, and three 'Hagiwara Sakura & Toyoda Misaki Yume no Tag Kessei! VS Yumb Yamamoto & Hornet Vol.1-3') on 2013-12-12, 2014-01-11, 02-12, 03-12, 04-12, 05-12: one per month, the exact six dates of the AniList entry. TVDB 272137 0x01-0x06 are 'Shocking Mud Wrestling!', 'Super Lotion Sumo!', 'Battle! Hot-Water Bath!', 'Dream Tag-Team Comes True! Vol. 1-3', the translations of those six Japanese titles, on the same dates. AniList has no episode titles, but the offline-database names the entry 'Specials / OVAs / Mini-Episoden'; no other special of the parent exists.
